name: comments
summary: Descriptive names over comments (owner, CHG-0045): a comment block may have at most two lines, each at most 100 characters. Lines that only cite spec, ADR or change IDs (SIMULATION-0001, SPEC-X R5) and tool directives are always allowed. Findings in tools/comments/baseline.json may only shrink. bd lint and the pre-commit hook run it.
outputs: JSON {findings, overBaseline, stale} on stdout; findings as file:line: message [rule] on stderr; exit 1 when a file has more than its baseline
